title: Hot tubs, spas, saunas and steam rooms: NEC Article 680 Part IV, IRC M1902 and makers' guidance
edition: NEC 2017–2023 Article 680 Part IV (secondary summaries); manufacturer installation guides
notes: NFPA 70 is behind a login; the distances are from secondary summaries that differ by edition, so findings are advisory. Outdoor spas follow the pool rules (680.22), whose receptacle distances the sources give as 6, 10 or 20 ft; only the indoor rules (680.43) are encoded. The floor load is a check prompt, not a structural design.

zones.description: About 3 ft (0.9 m) clear round a portable spa so its skirt panels and equipment bay can come off

spa.description: Receptacles at least 6 ft (1.83 m) from the inside wall of an indoor spa, wall switches at least 5 ft (1.52 m), luminaires and fans over it at least 7 ft 6 in (2.29 m) above the water; the filled spa and its bathers checked against the floor's 40 psf (1.92 kPa) residential live load, and a pad of at least 4 in (100 mm) of reinforced concrete on grade

sauna.id: IRC M1902 sauna; heater makers' sizing
sauna.description: A heater listed to UL 875 with a guard, a thermostat limiting the room to 194 °F (90 °C) with its sensor within 6 in (152 mm) of the ceiling (IRC M1902); heaters sized by room volume from one maker's table, 1.2 m³ added per m² of uninsulated surface and ×1.5 for log walls; clear height 2.1–2.44 m; about 1.15 m from the upper bench to the ceiling; the door opening outward without a lock (industry practice)

steam.description: The ceiling sloped at least 2 in per ft (1:6) so condensate runs to the walls, at most 8 ft (2.44 m) high and ideally 7 ft (2.13 m); the floor a pre-pitched bed falling ¼ in per ft to its drain (TCNA SR614); the steam head away from seats and benches (12–14 in); the generator's design volume from one maker's factors: fibreglass or acrylic ×0.65, ceramic tile ×1.0, glass tile or block ×1.35, natural stone ×1.65, +10 % a foot above 7 ft, +10 % with an outside wall (makers' factors differ, so a product's own replace them)
